name: MKX | 2g Disposable | Cherry Airheadz
description:
Inspired by the classic candy favorite, Cherry Airheadz delivers a mouthwatering blend of sweet cherry flavor and vibrant, feel-good energy. Bursting with juicy candy notes and a playful twist, this strain is crafted for consumers seeking a bold, nostalgic experience with every session.

Instructions:

Press 1X—Check Battery Life

Press 2X—Preheat Mode

Press 5X—Turn On/Off

Inhale Activated

Battery Life:

1 Light: -25%

2 Lights: 25-50%

3 Lights: 50-70%

4 Lights: 70-100%
